capabilities: Create the next free card note in a node folder (e.g. N1-3F.md)
Open or create the reverse side of a card (N1-3F to N1-3R)
Prefill new notes with ISO date, ordinal date and ISO week date
Configure root folder, cards per node and the note template
disambiguation: Not a card-style note viewer or canvas; it only creates and opens notes named after a paper index-card system.
extras: Version 0.1.1 and "Not yet tested at scale"; install is manual (git clone or release files); the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author wanted new notes to match the printed reference of a companion paper notebook so notes never start as "Untitled".
problem: New Obsidian notes start as "Untitled" and have no built-in way to match the numbered front/reverse card references of a printed paper notebook.
summary: Zettelkasten index-card note creator that makes notes named like N1-3F and N1-3R, pre-filled with ISO, ordinal and ISO week dates.
